annotations.title: Find a Directum RX error by log line

description: Match a log line, stack trace fragment or error message against the drxinfra.ru reference of about 200 errors seen around Directum RX: RX services and Directum Launcher, PostgreSQL, RabbitMQ, Elasticsearch, certificates and TLS, Keycloak and Kerberos, nginx, Docker and Kubernetes. Returns the best matches first, each with the exact error text, what it means, how to check and what to do (Russian), and the page link. Uses the same patterns and ranking as the search box on drxinfra.ru/errors/. Paste the error itself; remove passwords, tokens and personal data first.

limit.description: How many matches to return, best first

text.description: Log line or error text, as is. The first 16000 characters are checked.

name: find_error
title: Find a Directum RX error by log line
